title: Source-bound B1.10 irrigation ownership and dependency inventory

legacy_driver_order.daily_call: swap.f90 invokes Irrigation(3) inside flDayStart before TimeControl(9) and before subdaily soil-water stepping
legacy_driver_order.external_multiswap_adjustment: legacy MultiSWAP path may invoke Irrigation(4) to scale gird and event duration with f_irr_avail
legacy_driver_order.event_reset: Irrigation(9) resets current event fluxes/state at event end
solver_consumers: surface irrigation is converted through meteo/interception to nird and enters the top-boundary water flux
SSDI qssdi is consumed as a node source inside HeadCalc

derived_parameter_or_mapping_workspace: nod_ssdi derived from ss_irr_z and grid geometry
sensor node derived from dcrit and grid geometry
wclos/wcmes/wchis derived from hydraulic parameters and field-capacity/stress heads
calendar window anchors derived from month/day plus crop-year context

continuation_critical: current active-event identity where an event spans more than one solver interval
event timing information needed to continue an already-started SSDI/surface event

pressure_head: h(node) across rooted nodes for actual water content/deficit calculations through watcon(node,h(node))
hydraulic_parameter_evaluation: watcon(node,h(node)) during TCS2/TCS3/TCS4 and DCS1 runtime decisions

surface.meaning: gross irrigation rate is processed with interception/meteorology into net surface irrigation and then top-boundary inflow

temporary_workspace: current decision flags and non-continuation local scalars

day_count_management: TCS=6 weekly trigger increments dayfix once per Irrigation(3) call
tcsfix minimum interval increments dayfix once per Irrigation(3) call
timing_and_calendar_assumptions.hidden_driver_assumption: Irrigation(3) is called at flDayStart, so some counters mean calls-as-days rather than elapsed generic interval duration
timing_and_calendar_assumptions.event_duration: dt_irr_event is a fraction of a day and fixed-input validation forbids duration greater than one day

solver_coupling.existing_fsi10_capability: precomputed subsurface irrigation source can be supplied through the common source/sink provider
solver_coupling.target_rule: irrigation decides through a process contract and returns explicit flux/source; solver consumes that result through existing interfaces

examples: qssdisum/integral publication where not needed for continuation
reporting_only_history.rule: reporting accumulators are not part of compact committed irrigation state unless source-bound evidence proves they alter future irrigation decisions

legacy_io_dependencies.initialization: irrigation task 1 reads crop irrigation settings through rdinit/rds* calls and closes the crop file
legacy_io_dependencies.fixed_events: read_irrigation_fixed reads the main SWP stream or a separate .irg file using file units, pathwork, inquire/open/close and checkdate
legacy_io_dependencies.target_ownership: legacy adapter/translation layer outside the kernel

mass_ownership.composed_runtime_qssdi_accounting: fmr_serialized_reference_backend account_external_fluxes adds accepted qssdi*step_duration once to total_in for positive qssdi
mass_ownership.composed_runtime_surface_accounting: accepted top flux is included once in authoritative external flux accounting; an irrigation seam must feed this route rather than add a second process-authoritative total

optional_scaling.target: allocate compact irrigation continuation state and optional source arrays only for active irrigation profiles
